reviews.comment: Dr. Scherr is an amazing professor. He's very funny and cares a lot about the subject and the success of his students. I was in honors, and the structure of the class is very clear. As long as you do what you're supposed to do and communicate with him, you should get an A. I highly recommend this class and professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Scherr is a great professor! He started out the semester letting us know exactly what we needed to do to get an A and really wants his students to succeed. He was always available to help and was a kind, funny guy. It is a lot of group work but overall easy class as long as you turn everything in. Take him if you can!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Sebastian is one of the most caring and attentive professors Ive had at A&M. He gets back to you so fast and is super passionate about what he teaches. He gives amazing feedback and you can tell he wants you to get an A in his class (he makes it hard NOT to get an A). Take him if you get the chance!

Don't bother reading the reviews from UW-Madison. Dr. Scherr is a young professor still trying to figure out his teaching style - and he tells you that! He has an unmatched excitement for his field and students. His expectations are clear and fair. You're doing yourself a disservice if you choose not to take a class by him!

Sebastian was a great professor, he split up the assignments in a logical and easy to handle way, and always gave feedback on our presentations/how to do better. You can tell he is passionate about his field and always wants to help his students. Great prof to take your senior year!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Scherr really takes the time to make class interesting. He is such a caring prof, and is really engaging. I would absolutely take another one of his classes.
Sebastian is literally the best. He really cares about his students success and will go out of his way to help you!!! I would definitely take this professor again!!

This class was labeled as 'writing intensive' and it didn't seem like it at all! We had 3 papers (500 words each), 3 presentations with our groups, and social media discussion posts once a week. Professor Scherr made this class extremely interesting and fun! I would 100% recommend any student to take Professor Scheer for class!

He is such a great guy and such a great prof! I recommend him so highly and I encourage others to do the same. You won't regret it. You do have to put in the work don't get me wrong, but if you just do what he says you're going to get your money's worth. He cares a lot about his students and wants you to actually learn something.

LOVE LOVE LOVE him! He is amazing, hilarious, and class honestly was super fun. It is super great to enjoy going to class. It's discussion heavy which makes it super fun! If group projects aren't your thing then you might not want to take this course. If your group is bad then he will for sure help you out. We love Dr. Scherr! TAKE HIM.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Scherr is literally one of my favorite professors. He is such a chatty Kathy but he is REALLY invested in his students. Comm 470 didn't even feel like a writing intensive course. There were 3 papers, 3 group projects, and just social media discussion board posts. He is a great professor to get your feet wet in a writing intensive course!!
